nodes.label: GET-Zero: Graph Embodiment Transformer for Zero-shot Embodiment Generalization
nodes.norm_label: get-zero: graph embodiment transformer for zero-shot embodiment generalization

nodes.label: Graph Embodiment Transformer (GET)
nodes.rationale: Transformer encoder conditioned on robot hardware structure so one set of weights controls robots with varying joint counts and graph structures.

nodes.label: Per-joint Tokens with Local Hardware Properties
nodes.norm_label: per-joint tokens with local hardware properties

nodes.label: Self-modeling Forward Kinematics Prediction
nodes.rationale: Per-joint FK prediction as a meta-task empirically improves cross-embodiment transfer.

nodes.label: collate_embodiments
nodes.rationale: Pads a batch of embodiment graphs to the largest DoF count.

nodes.label: GetConfig.get_zero
nodes.rationale: Reproduces paper architecture: 8 layers, 16 heads, width 512, feed-forward 1024, dropout 0.1.

nodes.label: JointFeatureConfig
nodes.rationale: Default JointFeatureConfig() matches the paper's 6 fixed per-joint features.

nodes.label: GET Encoder Implementation
nodes.rationale: One input token per DoF with embodiment graphs read from URDF so it works for any tree-structured robot (hands, arms, quadrupeds, bipeds, humanoids); encoder only, no policy or self-modeling heads.

nodes.label: JointFeatureConfig.cross_embodiment (31 features)
nodes.rationale: Paper robots share joint axes so axes were unnecessary; across humanoids, quadrupeds and hands they differ, so axis, joint type, limits, effort/velocity limits, damping/friction, body mass/CoM/inertia and continuous 6D rotation are added.

nodes.label: Precomputed Graph Distances
nodes.rationale: Distances depend only on the robot, so EmbodimentGraph precomputes them instead of the encoder's Python loop.

nodes.label: Dynamic Mass Matrix Attention Bias
nodes.rationale: Repository addition beyond GET-Zero: normalized M(q) computed every step so the bias changes with configuration; disable with use_mass_encoding=False.

nodes.label: Mimic Joint Handling
nodes.rationale: Mimic joints are not independent DoFs so they are frozen at offset unless include_mimic_joints=True.

nodes.label: Multi-DoF Joint Expansion
nodes.rationale: Floating/planar joints become chains of 6 or 3 virtual 1-DoF joints so each DoF still gets one token.

nodes.label: Graph Distance Overflow Bucket
nodes.rationale: Unreachable pairs and distances above max_graph_distance share a bucket independent of batch padding.

nodes.label: Per-DoF Token T_j
nodes.rationale: T_j = [o_vg history, o_fg, o_vl,j history, o_fl,j]; history flattened feature-major as in GET-Zero code; layer norm over raw token then learned linear embedding.

nodes.label: Sibling Undirected Edges (independent serial chains)
nodes.rationale: Joins joints sharing a parent body (finger roots, quadruped hips, humanoid hips/waist, shoulders), matching GET-Zero's 'joints at the start of independent serial chains'.

nodes.label: URDF Embodiment Graph Construction
nodes.rationale: Parses URDF with the standard library only, no robotics dependencies; xacro must be expanded first.
